title: The Body Keeps the Score
author: Bessel van der Kolk
summary: Psychiatrist Bessel van der Kolk draws on decades of clinical work to explain how trauma changes the brain and body. He surveys approaches to healing, including yoga, neurofeedback, EMDR and theatre.
readIf: you want a wide-ranging account of how trauma works and the therapies used for it.
skipIf: you find case descriptions of abuse and war distressing, or want a how-to workbook.
